info.name: HighBond API Reference Actions Scheduled Hours API

params.name: org_id
params.description: The ID of the HighBond instance.

params.name: filter[date][start]
params.description: Requesting the API to filter results by start date. For more information, see Making requests

params.name: filter[date][end]
params.description: Requesting the API to filter results by end date. For more information, see Making requests

params.name: filter[schedule_type]
params.description: Requesting the API to filter results by schedule type. For more information, see Making requests Values can be: * `project` - for getting project schedules * `non_project` - for getting non project schedules

params.name: filter[scheduled_project_id]
params.description: Requesting the API to filter results by scheduled project IDs. For more information, see Making requests

params.name: fields[scheduled_hours]
params.description: Requesting the API to return only the specified fields. For more information, see Making requests

params.name: page[size]
params.description: The number of items returned per page. Default is 50. Maximum is 100.

params.name: page[number]
params.description: The Base64-encoded page number of records to return.

items.docs: Get scheduled hours for the user
